verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework built around server-rendered HTML, Axum routing, and small JS islands. Mobile targets are a fair axis for a UI framework, since some frameworks ship native-mobile counterparts. Nothing in the evidence mentions iOS, Android, or native mobile rendering; its render targets are HTML and Markdown, and its FFI support covers server languages only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reuse my framework skills and code to build performant native mobile apps for iOS and Android
